description: Serve hosted drops on the user's own domain (Pro/Team). Without slug, share.acme.com/<slug> serves every drop in the space; with slug, that one drop is served at the domain's root. Returns the DNS records the user must add (CNAME for a subdomain, A for an apex, plus a TXT if Vercel asks for ownership proof). HTTPS is automatic. Tell the user the exact records, then check with domain_status.

slug.description: Map the domain to just this drop.

space.description: Team handle, to connect it to a team space.

name: add_domain
title: Connect a custom domain
